backlogged.summary: redactDeep keeps object keys as they are. plan/approve `criteria` is keyed by criterion ids, which approve only accepts after lint validates them, so nothing leaks today. A later event keyed by free text would skip redaction.

Only `data` is redacted. recordEvent writes the top-level `feature` and `type` fields unchanged. Current callers pass F<n> ids (lint-contract records only contracts that loaded) and constant type names.
`harness events` prints stored lines without redacting them again. A line written before env_allowlist or the secrets changed, or written by another tool, is shown unchanged.

Event redaction relies on process.env at write time, like the run report. A secret that is not an environment variable of the process (for example, one typed directly into a contract) is written in plain text. This is the same rule as SR-8, so the contract accepts it.
